We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Customer Experience Manager (f/m/d) Your role

You are the interface between customers, Product and Sales. You support our customers, solve technical problems, and make sure fonio is integrated into their workflows successfully and for the long term.

What to expect

 * Customer care & support: You handle customer enquiries by email, chat and sometimes phone

 * Problem solving: You solve technical issues around telephony, SIP and integrations. If something gets too technically complex, you bring in the Product team

 * Product feedback: You are right next to the customer, so you feed your daily insights straight back to Product and help shape product development every day

 * Process management: You help build support processes that scale

 * Maintain the Help Center

 * Pass feedback on to the Product team

Who we're looking for

 * 2+ years in Customer Success or Support, ideally B2B SaaS

 * Technical understanding (API, SIP, VoIP)

 ** Experience with tools such as n8n, http://make.com/, Codex or similar

 * Ideal: experience with phone systems (PBX, VoIP, SIP)

 * Native-level German, good English skills

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €65,000-€80,000

 * Equity: you're helping build this, so you should get a share of it.

 * Food & drinks: in the Vienna office, lunch and dinner are on us (plus all the drinks your heart desires, and yes, we also have protein bars and vitamins).

 * Equipment of your choice: whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Application process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skills interview

 * 20 min culture fit with the founders

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

Founded in 2020 to solve the biggest challenges in the energy industry, enspired has been pushing the boundaries of innovation since day one. Driven by the belief that technology will make the energy transition a reality, we developed a state-of-the-art optimization platform in the early days of algo trading to integrate the flexibility we need for an efficient and sustainable energy system.

Today we know that future-proof battery revenues are the backbone of the renewable buildout. As the leader of the transparency movement in BESS revenue assessment, we publish verifiable commercial results to establish a new, reliable benchmarking standard that helps battery owners get a true understanding of what their asset is worth. 1 Junior Legal Expert (f/m/x) We are looking for a business-oriented in-house lawyer to take the entry-level position of a Junior Legal Expert and who wants to be at the forefront of shaping the most innovative energy asset optimization. As part of our Legal Team, you will be a vital support for the development of the company's business in international sales and commercial objectives with your legal expertise.

Provide solution-oriented legal support

With your passion for energy and contract law, you

º Support and drive our expansion and accelerate our sales cycles across Europe,

º Work in an international environment with regard to different jurisdictions,

º Gain experience and develop your legal skills in working on international contracts,

º Support the legal team in administrative tasks (legal housekeeping, contract management, etc.),

º Monitor applicable energy market laws (national and on the EU-level) and research ongoing developments.

Job requirements

How you fit into the team

You want to participate in the transition to clean energy actively, and you

º Have a master's degree in law, ideally in relation to the energy or contract law,

º Ideally can show first work experience or engagement in additional activities, projects and courses (e.g. moot courts, summer schools, volunteering),

º Are passionate about energy industry, in particular renewable energy and energy storage as well as artificial intelligence,

º Are striving to grow and develop your legal skills,

º Are proficient in English and German,

º Are proficient in Microsoft Word,

º Have a pro-active, solution-oriented attitude and a collaborative mind-set.

What's in it for you?

We believe in transparency and keep our colleagues updated on every aspect of our business. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of benefits

 * Hybrid and flexible working model

 * 30 days of vacation

 * 60 days of work from anywhere

 * Referral bonus

 * Extensive support of lifelong learners

 * Regular social events and holiday parties in Austria

 * Free lunch & fruits and fair-trade coffee at the office

 * Offsetting your private CO2 emissions

 * Sustainable enspired merch

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants. We offer an attractive salary which corresponds to your skills of at least EUR 65.000 gross per year.
